batches.command: python -m docdb_index apply --session sessions/demo --input samples/changes.json --batch-id incremental
batches.description: mixed key migrations, deletes and inserts in one atomic batch

batches.command: python -m docdb_index apply --session sessions/demo --input samples/changes.json --batch-id stale
batches.description: additional migrations and a delete for ledger/recovery checks

batches.command: python -m docdb_index apply --session sessions/demo --input samples/changes.json --batch-id isolation
batches.description: apply with --retain-stale to exercise query-time stale isolation

command_templates.bound_fault: python -m docdb_index inject --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount --type bound
command_templates.diagnose: python -m docdb_index diagnose --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount
command_templates.gui: python -m docdb_index gui --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount
command_templates.ledger_fault: python -m docdb_index inject --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount --type ledger
command_templates.normal_incremental: python -m docdb_index apply --session sessions/demo --input samples/changes.json --batch-id incremental --batch-size 2
command_templates.query_equality: python -m docdb_index query --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount --eq 42
command_templates.query_range: python -m docdb_index query --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount --range 0 100 --offset 0 --limit 10
command_templates.segment_fault: python -m docdb_index inject --session sessions/demo --collection orders --index metrics.amount --type segment
command_templates.snapshot_create: python -m docdb_index snapshot create --session sessions/demo --label snap-000001
command_templates.snapshot_restore: python -m docdb_index snapshot restore --session sessions/demo --snapshot snap-000001
command_templates.stale_history: python -m docdb_index apply --session sessions/demo --input samples/changes.json --batch-id stale --batch-size 1
command_templates.stale_window: python -m docdb_index apply --session sessions/demo --input samples/changes.json --batch-id isolation --retain-stale
